observations: Photo 0 shows a matching set of a kitchen extractor hood and a built-in gas hob.
The hood is an angled black glass chimney style with a digital display and touch controls.
The gas hob has 5 burners with heavy cast iron pan supports and a black glass base.
The brand 'SKY-OPPEIN' is visible on the glass of the hood and the bottom left corner of the hob in photo 0.
The items appear to be in a showroom or a very clean, new installation.
Model numbers are present below the brand logos but are too blurry to read.

identity.kind: Kitchen hood and 5-burner gas hob set

claims.claim: Set of kitchen hood gas cooker
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows both items together as a matching set.

risks.risk: The electronic touch controls or the extractor motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the hood powering on, cycling through fan speeds, and turning on lights.

risks.risk: Gas burners may have ignition issues or uneven flames.
risks.proof: A video showing all five burners being ignited and burning with a steady blue flame.

risks.risk: The glass surfaces may have hairline cracks or deep scratches not visible in the wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass panels under bright light.

risks.risk: Missing installation components like the chimney flue cover, grease filters, or gas connectors.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside of the hood (filters) and the loose installation accessories.

proof_requests: Clear, legible photos of the model/specification stickers for both the hood and the hob.
A video showing the hood's fan and lights working.
A video showing all 5 burners on the hob lighting and staying lit.
Photos of the underside of the hood to check the condition of the grease filters.
response.reason: The brand is identified, but the specific model numbers are unreadable. For high-value built-in appliances, the exact model and proof of functional status are required to determine a fair price.
